answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 51644 Country: Qatar Title: Rectification Question: (1) In second week of February I was in Jamat; I carried one small Book of Dua which I kept in top pocket of my Kurta. Many times went to toilet with that Dua Book being present in my pocket (which I forgot to take out). What I should do to for rectification? (2) Today I went to English toilet in my office, after I finished off with toilet; within seconds again toilet came and later I realized that it was semen like material or semen that came out but I offered Salah in that condition since I was in office and cannot go for ghusl. Is ghusl compulsory in this situation and I became profane? Answer ID: 51644 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 776/H-121/TH=05/1435) (1) It is enough to do taubah and istighfar. (2) If you are sure or there is great probability that the semen was discharged with lust then ghusl was wajib. It was not lawful to offer salah in that state. You should reoffer all the salah offered in that state besides doing taubah and istighfar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
